name: bound-late-answer
means: A late-eyes answer is taken into the review only while it is bound to the request it answers: the packet is bound to its target, a digest of the source tree and a digest of what it packed from the run records — each packed run's goal and status, its packed tasks as packed and the packed non-claims — the answer must carry the packet's fingerprint, and a missing binding, a replaced request, another target, a changed tree or a change to anything packed refuses the whole consume — the worker refuses before and after its host call, and the stop hook says nothing was decided — until a fresh request is answered; a record write that leaves what was packed as it was (an operation recorded on a task, a new task or run) refuses nothing, and a packet bound by 2.1.0 (records true) keeps the whole-records rule.
